info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Weather Alerts Radars-v3-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Radar API provides access to a comprehensive list of weather alerts and radar information. This API is essential for developers building applications that require real-time weather data, such as warning systems or weather monitoring applications. Users can retrieve detailed information about current weather alerts, ensuring timely and informed decision-making during adverse weather conditions. Typically, this API is utilized by meteorological services, mobile apps, and various consumer platforms that prioritize weather safety and awareness.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the latest radar alerts in a structured format. It is designed to provide real-time data on alerts for monitoring and analytics purposes.

requestBody.description: Request body to get radar alerts. This body is used to specify parameters related to the radar alerts you want to retrieve.

204.description: The request was successfully processed, but no content is returned.

ListWeatherAlertsRadarsRequest.description: This schema defines the request body for the GET operation related to '_s_alerts_s_radar_'. It holds a string value that serves as the input for the request.
